claims: A list of the interfaces of the scanned 935 head and of the quantities each one needs. No value is filled and nothing is measured. The twin's own fitted numbers appear only under twin_nominal_not_evidence, as what a checker would compare an admitted value with; they are never evidence for the value.

rules.value: null until an admitted source fills it. A value needs a source and an uncertainty; a bare figure is not admitted (decision 0019).
rules.source: the path of an admitted source record: a contribution under decision 0019 (capture protocol, explicit licence, anonymous specimen ID, review independent of the contributor, a second reader for interface dimensions) or a drawing of the identified variant. Never the twin, its params, its code or the scan.
rules.uncertainty: the expanded uncertainty of the value in the unit of its deviation (mm, or degrees for angles and directions); for a drawing, half the tolerance band.
rules.twin_values: never in value. A twin number sits only under twin_nominal_not_evidence, with its params file and key; comparable false means the twin's number is not the same measurand.
rules.threshold: the acceptance threshold T of the comparison, in the unit of the deviation. Null until committed in its own commit before any value arrives, at least twice the uncertainty (the pattern of decision 0024, step 3). It is an acceptance, not a dimension of the head.
rules.verdict: pass when |twin - value| <= T for a scalar, the distance between the points for a point, the angle between the axes for a direction (sign ignored), and equality for a designation or a count; fail otherwise; not_checkable when the value, the twin number, a comparable twin number or the threshold is missing, or T is less than twice the uncertainty.
rules.scale: a length comparison sets the twin at 1 scan unit = 1 mm, an owner instruction, against a measured length. Until #693 calibrates the scale, a fail of a length can be the scale and not the feature. Angles, directions, designations and counts do not depend on the scale.
rules.positions: a position is expressed in the twin frame of params/frame.json. A contributed position names the datum features it was measured from; it is transformed into the twin frame by a registration that names the features it used, and that registration is reviewed like the value.
rules.retiring_hypotheses: an admitted value retires a hypothesis only through the evidence named in its retire_with in hypotheses.json; the hypotheses register is edited by the commit that admits it.

preconditions.what: the specimen and its variant identified (head type, part number or casting marks). A drawing or specification applies only to an identified variant; a contributed measurement must name its specimen and say whether it is the scanned head.
one measured length that calibrates the scan. Until then every twin length is in scan units taken as millimetres by owner instruction.

blocker_codes.#692-identity: issue #692: the specimen and its variant are not identified
blocker_codes.#693-scale: issue #693: no measured length calibrates the scan
blocker_codes.drawing: a drawing or specification of the identified variant, with its licence recorded in a source record
blocker_codes.contribution-0019: a measurement of the specimen contributed and admitted under decision 0019; the project measures nothing itself and pays nobody to measure

blocker_fields.fill_with: any one of these can supply the value
blocker_fields.requires: must be closed before a value is admitted
blocker_fields.compare_requires: must be closed before a pass or fail states something about the specimen

frame.units: millimetres in the twin frame; angles in degrees; Z-up along the bore axis into the head
frame.definition_in_frame_json: origin on deck plane at register centre; Z = bore axis into the head; X = fin-normal hint A orthogonalised; Y = Z x X

A.what: the deck plane (combustion face); twin z = 0

B.what: the register recess centre on the deck plane: the twin origin. The twin's Z is the deck normal; the recess, a ring 5.5 mm long, gives no axis direction

C.what: the clocking about Z. In the twin, X is a fin-normal hint, not a feature a contributor can touch
C.blocker: a clocking feature a contributor can reach must be chosen and recorded before any contributed position is admitted; until then, positions are compared only as distances within one pattern (for example bolt_spacing), which need no clocking

load_paths.standing: declared for this contract so that every listed interface has a reason; not established. Each path names the interfaces it crosses; each crossing is blocked where its quantities are null.

paths.path: gas pressure on the chamber -> head body -> nut seats of the four stud passages -> head studs; reaction through the clamped face onto the barrel
paths.open: which face is clamped (deck_and_register.clamping_face), the head studs and their preload, the nut seats

paths.path: the part on the cam-side face -> six cam-side studs and their tapped holes -> head body
paths.open: the mating part, the tapped holes (H03), the pads

paths.path: manifold or exhaust mass, gas and thermal loads -> flange face and its two studs -> head body
paths.open: the role of each port (H09), the seal, the tapped holes (H03)

paths.path: valve closing load -> seat (insert, if any) -> head; spring force -> spring seat -> head; valve side load -> guide -> guide press fit -> head
paths.open: the seats, guides, inserts and their fits (H05); the valve, spring and cam (prepared-work.json, valve-train dynamics)

paths.path: plug tightening torque and gas pressure -> plug thread and seat face -> head body
